name: Okta large-scale DPRK IT-worker interview dataset

attribution.legal_posture: Security-vendor research finding; legal identity and adjudication remain outside the finding.

caveats: Counts represent linked actors, interviews and companies; unique confirmed DPRK nationals and successful infiltrations require separate counts.
Okta intentionally withholds the visibility mechanism and makes no claim that every observed company hired an actor.

statements: Okta's September 2025 analysis linked more than 130 actors to more than 6,500 initial job interviews across more than 5,000 distinct companies through mid-2025.
Okta said the activity crossed almost every vertical and geography rather than remaining limited to U.S. big technology companies.
